spec.data_source: Two authenticated native GETs of each exact selected object, coherent UID/resourceVersion/metadata and bounded pinned offline detector output.
spec.predicate: Inspects only top-level labels and annotations of explicitly selected objects with both offline detectors. Native UID, resourceVersion and metadata must remain coherent across two exact reads; other object contents are not inspected.

description.pass_when: Both detectors finish without a supported secret in the fully collected selected metadata.
description.fail_when: A supported credential-like value is detected in independently bound selected metadata; incomplete scope is stated explicitly.
description.not_applicable_when: No supported selected object is available; denied, missing, changed or incomplete negatives remain UNKNOWN.
